nodes.label: Isolated Workspaces (Scope Filter)
nodes.rationale: Security by construction: isolation lives in the data-access layer, not UI hiding; foreign task IDs return 404 not 403 so existence is not leaked.

nodes.label: Convention: Task Endpoints Use Scope Filter + 404 Test
nodes.norm_label: convention: task endpoints use scope filter + 404 test

nodes.label: 3NF Schema with UUIDv4 Keys
nodes.rationale: UUIDv4 primary keys eliminate auto-increment enumeration exploits (IDOR); TIMESTAMPTZ UTC discipline.

nodes.label: Legacy Spreadsheet Problem
nodes.rationale: Excel lacks access control, relational integrity, proactive warnings and audit trail - motivating the platform.

nodes.label: Positioning: Spreadsheet -> AI Workspace
nodes.rationale: Excel round-trip is the on-ramp, Copilot the payoff, scope filtering makes it safe for enterprise adoption.

nodes.label: Principle: Meet teams where they are (Excel in, Excel out)
nodes.norm_label: principle: meet teams where they are (excel in, excel out)

nodes.label: Bidirectional Excel Data Center (round-trip)
nodes.rationale: Excel round-trip is the on-ramp: teams migrate gradually and keep stakeholders who want a sheet.

nodes.label: IDOR Immunity / Inviolable Scope Filtering
nodes.rationale: Regular users get 404 (not 403) on other users' task IDs so existence is not leaked.

nodes.label: Excel Round-Trip (Import Preview / Export)
nodes.rationale: Low switching cost: teams migrate gradually and stakeholders can keep spreadsheets.

nodes.label: Excel Status/Priority Mapping Rules
nodes.rationale: Legacy statuses normalised (Pending/To Do->todo, Under Review->in_review); unknown->todo/medium; empty title held back.

nodes.label: Excel Two-Way Synchronization with Import Preview
nodes.norm_label: excel two-way synchronization with import preview
nodes.rationale: Import validates and previews schema discrepancies before DB commit to prevent bad data.

nodes.label: Design System Tokens (Linear/Notion inspired)
nodes.rationale: Restrained, light-first, information-dense aesthetic; zero decorative clutter.

nodes.label: Four Ways to Work (List, Kanban, Calendar, Drawer)
nodes.norm_label: four ways to work (list, kanban, calendar, drawer)

nodes.label: Access/Refresh Token Rotation
nodes.rationale: 60-minute access tokens; Axios interceptor queues requests and refreshes; refresh tokens single-use, stored as hashes.

nodes.label: Dual-Engine AI Task Copilot
nodes.rationale: LLM when a key is configured, deterministic heuristics otherwise, so it works offline / air-gapped.

nodes.label: Kairo
nodes.rationale: Replaces a shared Excel workbook with a secure AI-assisted task workspace without forcing teams to abandon Excel on day one.

nodes.label: Out of Scope (Notifications, SSO, Mobile, Multi-tenancy)
nodes.norm_label: out of scope (notifications, sso, mobile, multi-tenancy)

nodes.label: Success Measures
nodes.rationale: Proposed targets: 100% work in Kairo, 0 cross-user exposures, every task owned with valid status.

nodes.label: JWT_SECRET_KEY Default Startup Guard
nodes.rationale: Startup fails on Vercel if JWT_SECRET_KEY is the public default.

nodes.label: Shared Excel Workbook Problem
nodes.rationale: Drifting free-text statuses, unowned rows, everyone sees every row, no audit trail, no planning help.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control (Admin / User)
nodes.rationale: Admins get full visibility; regular users are a strict personal sandbox with zero leakage across endpoints.

nodes.label: AI Task Copilot
nodes.rationale: No vendor lock: deterministic offline engine works without an API key; LLM optional.

nodes.label: AI Copilot Parse-Task Flow
nodes.rationale: Drafts are never auto-saved; user confirms. Copilot calls logged in ai_interactions and read only scoped tasks.

nodes.label: System Architecture (React SPA -> FastAPI -> SQLAlchemy -> Neon)
nodes.norm_label: system architecture (react spa -> fastapi -> sqlalchemy -> neon)

nodes.label: JWT Secret Startup Guard
nodes.rationale: Function refuses to start on Vercel while JWT_SECRET_KEY is the public dev default, otherwise anyone could forge admin tokens.

nodes.norm_label: stateless jwt with refresh token rotation
nodes.rationale: 60-minute access tokens plus revocable hashed 7-day refresh tokens.
